# Mitigation Summary

## Action
Create a dedicated CloudWatch guardrail alarm (ebs-skill-eval-d-fis-guardrail, VolumeQueueLength Average > 32 for 2 of 2 one-minute periods on vol-0123456789abcdef0_2) and set it as the stop condition of FIS experiment template EXTfpFLs9urWUme, replacing 'none'.

## Reasoning
Both alarm episodes on 2026-11-11 (01:11–01:15 and 15:33–15:47 UTC) were caused by template EXTfpFLs9urWUme injecting 500 ms EBS I/O latency (EXP4Xs8yABzn38YDgv, EXP7SDntcG3Ff1fsx). The template has no stop conditions, so every run lasts the full 15 minutes with no automatic abort. A run is expected to push queue length to about 16, so using the existing alarm (threshold 4) as the stop condition would end every run early. A guardrail at 32 (~2x the expected peak) stops only runs that exceed the planned impact. The existing alarm has no actions, so it stays unchanged. Raising gp3 IOPS or throughput would not help: the IOPS drop came from the injected latency, not from a provisioned limit.
